rules.title: Bundle Size Budget
rules.bad_example: import { HeavyChart } from './HeavyChart'; // Bundled in main.js
rules.good_example: const HeavyChart = lazy(() => import('./HeavyChart')); // Separate chunk

rules.title: Tree Shaking
rules.check: Avoid "Barrel Files" (index.ts) that re-export everything if they break tree-shaking.

rules.title: Memoization
rules.bad_example: const sorted = items.sort(); // Runs on every render!

rules.title: Debounce and Throttle
rules.bad_example: <input onChange={doSearch} /> // API call on every keystroke

rules.title: Avoid Memory Leaks
Minimize Dependencies
rules.check: Do not import huge libs for small tasks (e.g., Lodash).

rules.title: Image Optimization
rules.check: Images MUST be optimized (WebP/AVIF) and sized correctly.

rules.title: Avoid Render Blocking
rules.check: Third-party scripts MUST be async or defer.

rules.title: Web Workers for Heavy Computation
rules.check: CPU-intensive operations (>50ms) MUST be offloaded to Web Workers.

rules.title: Service Worker Caching
rules.check: Static assets MUST be cached via Service Worker for offline support and performance.
rules.bad_example: // No service worker - every page load fetches from network

rules.title: CSS-in-JS Extraction
rules.check: CSS-in-JS MUST extract static styles at build time. Runtime style generation forbidden in hot paths.

rules.title: Compiler-Optimized Reactivity
rules.check: Prefer compiler-optimized reactivity (React Compiler, Solid, signals) over manual memoization.
